title: Senior Total Rewards Partner
descriptionHtml:
About Docker

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

Docker is looking for a Senior Total Rewards Partner to design, manage, and improve compensation, equity, and benefits programs for our global team.

You’ll bring broad compensation expertise and pair strong analytical skills with clear communication, helping build out and maintain, as well as execute, our total rewards philosophy, helping leaders make informed decisions and employees understand their total rewards. Working across functions, you’ll build programs that support Docker’s goals and help us attract, retain, and motivate great talent.

Responsibilities

Compensation

  • Own and evolve core compensation programs, including our job architecture, base pay structures, merit and promotion cycles, and market benchmarking.

  • Design and manage new hire and retention equity programs, including restricted stock unit (RSU) grant guidelines, vesting structures, and refresh strategies that support attraction and long-term retention.

Global Benefits

  • Manage and improve benefits programs across Docker’s entities in the United States, United Kingdom, Netherlands, Germany, and France, partnering with local brokers and vendors to maintain compliant, competitive offerings.

  • Balance local requirements and employee needs with a consistent global approach to total rewards, and help employees understand the benefits available to them.

Data, Analytics, and Business Partnership

  • Build models, dashboards, and analyses that support compensation decisions, budget planning, and market benchmarking.

  • Translate data into clear recommendations, helping the business understand costs, options, and tradeoffs.

  • Anticipate how changes in Docker’s business and talent needs should shape our total rewards programs.

  • Partner with cross-functional leaders to make informed, consistent rewards decisions.

Communication and Change Management

  • Lead communication and change planning for total rewards initiatives, involving stakeholders early and preparing managers to support their teams.

  • Create clear communications, manager talking points, and FAQs that explain what is changing, why it matters, and how it affects employees.

  • Help employees and leaders understand how compensation, equity, and benefits fit together as part of Docker’s total rewards strategy.

  • Serve as a trusted advisor on total rewards, bringing sound judgment, reliable follow-through, and a willingness to share expertise and mentor teammates.

Qualifications

Required

  • 8+ years of progressive compensation experience, including ownership of core compensation programs.

  • Direct experience building and administering new hire and retention equity programs, including RSUs.

  • Strong analytical skills, including advanced modeling and the ability to turn complex data into practical recommendations.

  • Experience working with compensation planning tools.

  • A track record of aligning total rewards programs with business priorities and talent strategy.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex rewards topics clearly to employees and leaders.

  • The ability to work independently, navigate ambiguity, learn quickly and exercise sound judgment while building trust across functions.

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting benefits programs in a global, multi-entity environment.

  • Experience at a high-growth SaaS or technology company.

  • Experience with benefits programs in the United Kingdom, Netherlands, Germany, or France.

  • Certified Compensation Professional (CCP) or a similar certification.

Compensation & Equity

United States: $141,750– $202,500 + equity

______________________________________________________________________

Posting Information

  • Open vacancy: This posting is for an existing open role.

  • AI in hiring: Docker may use AI-assisted tools during our recruiting process.

  • Interview recordings: Candidates will be invited to opt in to interview recordings to support interviewer calibration and consistent evaluations. Recordings are optional and require explicit consent.

______________________________________________________________________

Perks & Benefits

  • Remote-first by design – Work from your home, with offices in Seattle and Paris for connection and collaboration.

  • Flexibility that fits your life – We trust you to manage your schedule while delivering great work.

  • Time to recharge – Generous PTO, designated quarterly Whaleness Days, and a designated end-of-year Whaleness break.

  • Home office support – Set up your workspace for comfort and success.

  • Technology stipend – Equivalent to US$100 net per month to help support your work.

  • Learning & development – Annual stipend for conferences, courses, certifications, and continued learning.

  • Parental leave – 16 weeks of paid parental leave after six months of employment.

  • Equity for all full-time employees – Share in Docker's long-term success as we continue to grow.

  • Comprehensive benefits – Medical, retirement, and paid holidays vary by country.

  • Docker swag – Because representing the whale never gets old.

Docker is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe diverse teams build better products, make better decisions, and better serve our global community.

#LI-REMOTE
